summary: Oramed Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting two events. First, board approved amendments to its bylaws regarding record dates and written consent procedures. Second, the company agreed with Scilex Holding to extend maturity of senior secured promissory notes (Tranche A ~$29.5M, Tranche B ~$6.7M) plus a $1M cash extension fee payable by Scilex. No special-situation deal terms such as price, premium, or change of control are involved. This is a routine operational and debt extension filing.
